transport: 🚆 Choose rail or electric coaches over domestic/short-haul flights — cuts journey emissions by up to 80-90%.
🚲 Use bike-share systems, e-scooters, and walk whenever possible in urban centers.
🚌 Purchase multi-day regional public transit passes for seamless train, tram, and ferry access.
🚗 If driving is essential, opt for electric vehicle (EV) rentals or carpool rideshares.
accommodation: 🏨 Seek out eco-certified lodgings (Green Key, EarthCheck, LEED, EU Ecolabel, Bio-Hotels).
💡 Hang towels to reuse multiple days; decline daily housekeeping to save water and detergents.
❄️ Adjust thermostats moderately (turn off AC/heating when exploring the city).
🚿 Keep showers short (under 5 minutes) to conserve local freshwater resources.
dining: 🥗 Prioritise plant-forward, vegetarian, and farm-to-fork dining — cuts dietary carbon by ~50%.
🍎 Shop at neighbourhood farmers' markets and family-owned bakeries/grocers to support the local economy.
🍷 Choose certified organic, biodynamic, and locally produced wines, beers, and ciders.
🍽️ Avoid all single-use cutlery and ask for tap water in refillable carafes where potable.
wildlife_nature: 🐾 Never participate in exploitative wildlife encounters (no riding elephants, petting drugged tigers, or holding captive sea turtles).
🌿 Adhere strictly to the 7 Principles of 'Leave No Trace' — stay on marked trails and pack out all rubbish.
🪸 Wear non-nano zinc reef-safe sunscreen when swimming in oceans, cenotes, and lakes to protect coral ecosystems.
🔇 Maintain quiet in natural reserves to avoid distressing birds and native fauna.
cultural_community: 🛍️ Buy souvenirs directly from local indigenous artisans and craftspeople rather than mass-produced imports.
👗 Respect local dress codes and cultural norms when visiting sacred monuments, temples, and villages.
💬 Learn basic greeting phrases in the local language (e.g. hello, please, thank you, delicious).
🤝 Choose community-based tour guides whose fees stay directly inside the visited neighbourhood.
